content.title: Malkajgiri Police Arrest Seven in Illegal Loan Racket
content.caption: Police arrest seven in illegal loan racket involving large interest and blank signed cheques.

slides.heading: Police Arrest
slides.text: Seven arrested in illegal loan racket involving large interest and blank signed cheques.
slides.image_search_query: police arrest illegal loan racket India

slides.heading: Details
slides.text: The accused approached borrowers through known persons and intermediaries, promised substantial loans and deducted hefty amounts as advance interest.

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: The gang obtained promissory notes, bonds and blank signed cheques for amounts substantially higher than the loans actually advanced.
